_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Base-rate coil statistics plus non-accelerating mid-range momentum/funding keep the score inside 55-62; no breaker is visible yet.
next_move.brains_agree: Analyst explicit HOLD in Disbelief; narrative silent on forward phase so no direct conflict, consensus follows analyst
next_move.confirmed_if: Phase score holds 55-62 with 30d momentum still capped near mid-50s and funding flat
next_move.invalidated_if: Momentum breaks above ~70 and funding heats toward 75 (up into Hope), or long-unwind drives score down through 54 into Complacency
